intent: Implement the admitted Sarathi P0 composition root: one lazy, ingress-neutral async handle_turn API with a version-controlled identity, repository provider-backed cognition, shared RuntimeState persistence and receipts, typed fail-closed effects, an import-safe compatibility boundary, and one durable build-lineage/index location. Add only the generic RuntimeStateStore event-plus-receipt transaction seam needed for truthful atomic completion; do not move or fork shared engines or legacy Sarathi organs.

gates.name: sarathi-root-contracts
gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_runtime_state.py tests/test_sarathi_public_api.py tests/test_sarathi_shell.py tests/test_sarathi_import_boundaries.py tests/test_holon_system_imports.py

gates.name: sarathi-root-ruff
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check dharma_swarm/runtime_state.py dharma_swarm/sarathi tests/test_runtime_state.py tests/test_sarathi_public_api.py tests/test_sarathi_shell.py tests/test_sarathi_import_boundaries.py

negative_controls.name: executed-effect-requires-authority-and-receipt
negative_controls.command:
python3 -c "import sys; from dharma_swarm.sarathi.contracts import EffectReport, EffectStatus; exec('try:
 EffectReport(status=EffectStatus.EXECUTED)
except ValueError:
 sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)')"

commit.message: feat(sarathi): establish the persistent-agent composition root

interface_mismatches: Sarathi has planning, delegation, proof, and bounded wake organs but no stable message-to-reply owner; MCP exposes only read-only status and roster.
Current direct tool runners do not validate the canonical ExecutionLease immediately before every effect, so P0 effects must remain typed BLOCKED.
Existing identity loading requires mutable host state under ~/.dharma/agents; Sarathi needs a source identity that survives a clean host and can evolve through Git.
honest_blockers: This stacked branch cannot merge before governance PR #1215 lands.
P0 is one real dialogue-and-receipt path, not a full Hermes/OpenClaw-class shell; tool execution, transport mounts, scheduler, memory retrieval, and self-modification remain follow-on adapters.
No liveness claim is made: importing or calling one turn does not prove a standing service.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the additive dharma_swarm/sarathi package, its tests, the generic RuntimeStateStore event-plus-receipt transaction seam and receipt-layer declaration, the persistent-agent index/lineage additions, and this packet. The existing state schema remains unchanged.
